raw.query:
WITH encoder AS (
  SELECT n_images, mean_ms, ms_per_img, source_path, engine, image_px, is_valid, note
  FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn
  WHERE source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/oneworker_artifact/silicon_burst3.json'
    AND engine = 'aic'
    AND image_px = 448
    AND n_images IN (1, 64)
    AND is_valid = true
), ratio_backing AS (
  SELECT run_id, denominator_kind, cost_ratio
  FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio
  WHERE is_current = true
    AND cost_ratio BETWEEN 1.645 AND 1.655
)
SELECT
  MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 1) AS f1_ms,
  MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 64) AS f64_ms,
  MAX(ms_per_img) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 64) AS f64_ms_per_image,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ratio_backing) AS matching_current_v_cost_ratio_rows,
  MAX(source_path) AS source_path,
  MAX(note) AS note
FROM encoder;
